description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named CustomerProductReviewController, responsible for handling customer product reviews in an e-commerce application. It manages displaying existing reviews, submitting new reviews, and ensures customer authorization.

classes.name: CustomerProductReviewController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing product reviews by customers, extending AbstractController for shared functionality.

methods.name: displayProductReview
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product review page, fetching product details, existing customer review, and preparing the model for the view.

methods.name: submitProductReview
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit a new product review, performing validation, checking for existing reviews, saving new reviews, and preparing response.
